description: JavaScript code for a carousel slideshow, including configuration variables, image handling, and animation functions.

methods.name: Carousel
methods.description: Initializes the carousel, creates image elements, and starts the animation.

methods.name: CarImages
methods.description: Handles the positioning and updating of carousel images during animation.

methods.name: C_LdLnk
methods.description: Opens linked URL in a new window when an image is clicked.

methods.name: C_Stp
methods.description: Stops the carousel animation on mouse over.

methods.name: C_Rstrt
methods.description: Restarts the carousel animation on mouse out.
